prose: Short note from feed metadata only: the Wall Street Journal reports that Lumaril, which optimizes industrial production by plugging AI into factories' existing control systems, has raised a $66 million Series A at a $400 million valuation. The pitch - no rip-and-replace, just better decisions on top of installed systems - is the pragmatic end of industrial AI. The source is paywalled, so investors and customer details are unverified.
highlights: Lumaril raises a $66M Series A at a $400M valuation, per the WSJ
Product: AI optimization of industrial production via existing control systems - no rip-and-replace
The pragmatic end of industrial AI
